items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-08-31
items.q: They had pictures of Big Eye, Louie, and people.

ctx.x: I don't suppose he would have any written material or pictures of anything like that?

No, he had good pictures at that time. I was hoping to get some of those pictures, which I didn't copy all of them. They had pictures of Big Eye, Louie, and people. I remember one in the boxing match of Big Eye and Freddie Keppert outside the theater. They had their fists up as if they were boxing. A few other good pictures, which I didn't, it cost too much to reproduce them, I guess, at the time. The Jazzman, I didn't see all of them at that time either.
